note: Human-editable housing search filters. `required` holds the four Phase 1 base criteria; `optional` holds every preference (null/[] = no restriction). Multi-value filters take a JSON array of strings; ranged filters take `_min`/`_max` pairs where null leaves that side open. Valid values, defaults, and encoding rules are documented in Architecture.md 'Phase 2 — Configurable Search Filters'.

optional.note: Ranged filters: null on either side = open bound (e.g. `price=550000-`, `garage_capacity=-5`). Multi-value filters: ordered JSON arrays of strings, comma-joined and percent-encoded (null/[] = no restriction); `construction_type` also accepts a bare string (legacy `existing`/`new` are mapped to `resale`/`newly_built`). `garden` (bool) is a legacy shorthand for `exterior_space_type` containing "garden"; `garden_size_min` applies only when a garden is selected.
